scenario: Community search over user posts, questions, answers, and comments. Primary metrics: relevance (nDCG) and click-through rate; focus on semantic matching, query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and LLM-assisted search.

papers.title: FALCA: Falsification-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Deep Search Agents
papers.authors: Zijun Dou, Kun Luo, Chaofan Li, Shuqi Lu, Zheng Liu
papers.summary: Deep search can reinforce an early mistaken hypothesis. FALCA separates answer proposals from independent counterevidence searches and trains research-state revision with hierarchical credit. Its 4B model reaches 56.0% accuracy on BrowseComp.
papers.key_insight: Give counterevidence checking its own context. A useful falsification report names conflicting evidence and unmet constraints, giving the next search a specific gap to resolve.

papers.title: DeclineCraft: A RAG Abstention Benchmark for Jointly Measuring Combined Retrieval and Parametric Knowledge
papers.authors: Atharva Thakur, Abulhair Saparov, Bruno Ribeiro
papers.summary: DeclineCraft tests whether models abstain when neither retrieved evidence nor internal knowledge supports an answer. Version-specific Minecraft questions allow controlled knowledge cutoffs. Iterative retrieval reduces correct abstention in 30 of 40 configurations.
papers.key_insight: Evaluate retrieval depth separately from reliability. Track both accuracy on answerable questions and abstention when evidence is missing; a willingness to answer is not evidence coverage.

papers.title: Do Conversational Agents Need Explicit Memory? A Controlled Comparison with Raw-History Retrieval
papers.authors: Yongjie Zhou, Shuai Wang, Bevan Koopman, Guido Zuccon
papers.summary: A controlled comparison asks whether explicitly constructed memories outperform retrieval over raw conversation history. Across six systems and two benchmarks, gains are localized rather than consistent. Oracle retrieval separates construction losses from access failures.
papers.key_insight: Diagnose preservation and access separately. Oracle retrieval can reveal whether to improve memory construction or retrieval, before paying for more elaborate persistent representations.

papers.title: Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.authors: Mingyuan Li, Yucheng Li, Xiaxia Wang, Gong Cheng
papers.summary: OACR estimates how adjacent knowledge-graph search states change the expected outcome, then reweights token updates without reversing the trajectory advantage. With Qwen2.5-7B, it improves CWQ F1 by 4.6 points over outcome-only GRPO.
papers.key_insight: Use local progress to change update magnitude while leaving final success in charge of its direction. The state evaluator runs only during training, avoiding an extra inference-time judge.

papers.title: COMPASS: Routing via Capability-Oriented Model Profiling with Adaptive Search, Selection, and Tool Use
papers.summary: COMPASS chooses models by consulting performance and cost records through tools, rather than training a dedicated router. It can inspect candidate answers before selection and update its choices as records change. LLMRouterBench accuracy reaches 69.85%.
papers.key_insight: Make model capabilities queryable records. Count the router and candidate inspections in end-to-end cost when assessing whether this approach saves money.

papers.title: Evolving Self-tuning Benchmarks for Long-Horizon Tool Use
papers.authors: Hyunji Alex Nam, Michael Dennis, Natasha Jaques, Minsuk Chang
papers.summary: TURTLE evolves tool-use evaluations with a task proposer, solver, and feedback generator. Solver traces guide tasks toward a difficult but solvable range. On AppWorld, the share of hard tasks increases by 165%.
papers.key_insight: Use execution traces to calibrate task difficulty continuously. Failure locations give a task generator more useful guidance than a single success bit.

papers.title: FinHopper: A Progressive Multi-Hop Benchmark for Complex Financial Agents with Step-wise Evaluation
papers.authors: Yuxuan Wu, Miaopei Lin, Qiufang Ying, Lin Dan, Hao Zhao, Qirui Liu, Yuteng Shen, Shaohui Wu, Weihong Luo, Xiku Du, Xing Tang, Hao Chen
papers.summary: FinHopper evaluates financial search chains whose intermediate entities, dates, and indicators determine later queries. Gold intermediate answers expose where a chain breaks. The study compares 20 model-agent configurations.
papers.key_insight: Use typed intermediate checkpoints. Separate a wrong inherited constraint from missing evidence or a final synthesis error, rather than collapsing every failure into an incorrect final answer.

papers.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
papers.authors: Saaket Agashe, Yuzhe Yang, Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega, Bhuvan Chandra Koduru, Chih-Lun Li
papers.summary: Agent S4 evolves tool interfaces and usage knowledge from execution traces, then selects repositories on unseen validation tasks. With the same model, its OSWorld V2 binary score is 3.8 times the fixed-interface baseline.
papers.key_insight: Treat interfaces as an optimization target. Select interface versions on independent tasks and record the underlying model, so improvements remain attributable and reusable.

papers.title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
papers.authors: Ruhan Wang, Yucheng Shi, Zongxia Li, Junyao Yang, Zhongzhi Li
papers.summary: RiseHarness compares successful and failed runs of the same task, using internal execution traces to revise shared harness mechanisms without changing model weights. DeepSeek-V4-Flash gains 7.25 percentage points in mean TBH success.
papers.key_insight: Attach executable evidence to completion decisions. Record command dispatch, observations, and completion checks separately to locate reliability failures in the harness.

papers.title: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
papers.summary: Terminal X encodes firm-specific investment standards and uses a separate evaluation agent to check research outputs. The vendor case study reports 88.6% agreement with senior investor judgment.
papers.key_insight: Make institutional standards explicit and inspectable. This customer case does not publish a complete test set; its transferable contribution is the separation of research generation and firm-specific evaluation.
